description: Inputs passed to the Arkham entity-aware wallet policy WASM at evaluation time

address.description: Destination address (0x-prefixed) to attribute and screen with Arkham.

chain.description: Optional Arkham chain identifier (e.g. 'ethereum', 'base', 'arbitrum_one'). Arkham returns per-chain labels, tags and activity for the same address, so omitting this widens the lookup to every supported chain.

transaction_amount_usd.description: USD notional of the proposed transaction, used by the Rego tiering rules. CALLER-SUPPLIED and therefore NOT attested - see this pack's README. Defaults to 0 when omitted, which places the transaction in the most permissive tier.
